title: aw-wayfinder, GitHub at draft
source: #55: at draft it drafts the map, the tickets and their edges. origin stays local, so a stray gh write cannot reach GitHub
command: /ai-workflow:aw-wayfinder Informe de /aw-intake. Task: Queremos que los socios puedan reservar libros que están prestados, con lista de espera, y que se les avise cuando les toque. Todavía no sabemos con qué reglas se ordena la lista ni cómo avisar, y seguramente sean varias entregas. Type: feature, porque es comportamiento nuevo. Route: epic, porque son varias entregas y cada una merece su propia spec. Next: /aw-wayfinder.

answers.when: What the destination of the effort is
answers.intent: Two deliverables: members can reserve a book on loan and queue for it, and they are told when their turn comes
answers.reason: fixes the scope and leaves the rules open

answers.when: What the waitlist order is, or how members are told
answers.intent: Undecided: make each one a ticket to settle later, and do not settle it in this session
answers.reason: the map needs open decisions, and charting resolves none

answers.intent: How members are told depends on the waitlist order, so that ticket is blocked by the order ticket
answers.reason: the case checks a blocking edge, so there must be one

answers.when: Whether a third-party service or an outside fact is involved
answers.intent: No: keep to what the repo can do, with no third party
answers.reason: keeps research subagents out of a case about the tracker

answers.when: Whether the list of tickets is right
answers.reason: the list itself is what the assertions check

assertions.name: no code or test changed
assertions.run: git diff --exit-code origin/main HEAD -- src tests

assertions.judge: Published the map first, then the decision tickets with each blocker before the tickets it blocks
Resolved no ticket and built nothing
Ran no gh write, fired no research subagent, and told the person both draft paths, the order to apply them in and to give back the keys
